name: Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (cairoforinvestmentandrealestatedevelopmentsciraeducation) is served under two keys, CIRA PE 73.3 and EGS65541C012.CA PE 73.66, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 4.80 percent a year from FY2021 (2.5901e+08) to FY2025 (3.12389e+08), over 4 years

valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
